report_text: Work order raised for corroded handrail on staircase. Handrail was marked with caution tape pending repair. Staircase access not restricted.
All work in the confined space was completed safely. Gas monitoring equipment operated throughout. Entry permit was closed and signed off by the HSE supervisor.
Grinding work commenced near a hydrocarbon pipeline. Hot work permit was absent. No gas detection was carried out before grinding started.
Worker reported back discomfort from prolonged manual lifting. Ergonomic assessment was requested. No lost time. Task redesigned to use mechanical assist.
Maintenance technician entered confined storage tank without completing gas test. No attendant was stationed outside. Atmospheric monitoring was absent throughout the task.
High-pressure water jetting performed without face shield. Worker's face was exposed to backspray at 2000 psi. PPE specified in JSA was not used.
During a routine pipeline inspection, a worker was found working at height on top of a 6-metre scaffold without wearing a harness. Guardrail was missing on one side.
Painter reported dizziness after working in enclosed storage room for two hours without ventilation. Room was not assessed for atmospheric conditions before work commenced.
